definitions.sourceLipschitzConstant: def sourceLipschitzConstant (k : Nat) : Real := 2 * ExperimentalCoefficientRange.coarseBound k * (2*k+2:Real) * (2*k+1:Real) * 2^(2*k+1)
definitions.radiusGrid: def radiusGrid (n : Nat) (R : Real) (j : Fin(gridSize(n+1))) : Real := -R+2*R*(j.val:Real)/(gridSize(n+1):Real)
definitions.radiusVector: noncomputable def radiusVector (k n : Nat) (R : Real) : EuclideanSpace Complex (Fin(gridSize(n+1))) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => (HermitePolynomial.smoothInitial k (radiusGrid n R j):Complex))

exact_signatures: theorem sourceInterpolant_lipschitz (k : Nat) (x y : Real) (hx : x in Set.Icc(-1)0) (hy : y in Set.Icc(-1)0) : abs((HermitePolynomial.sourceInterpolant k).eval x-(HermitePolynomial.sourceInterpolant k).eval y) <= sourceLipschitzConstant k * abs(x-y)
theorem smoothInitial_lipschitz (k : Nat) (x y : Real) : abs(HermitePolynomial.smoothInitial k x-HermitePolynomial.smoothInitial k y) <= sourceLipschitzConstant k * abs(x-y)
theorem radius_grid_difference (n : Nat) (R S : Real) (j : Fin(gridSize(n+1))) : abs(radiusGrid n R j-radiusGrid n S j) <= abs(R-S)
theorem radiusVector_error (k n : Nat) (R S : Real) : norm(radiusVector k n R-radiusVector k n S) <= Real.sqrt(gridSize(n+1):Real) * sourceLipschitzConstant k * abs(R-S)
theorem radiusVector_source (k n : Nat) (L : Real) : radiusVector k n (Real.pi*L)=ExperimentalNormalizationStability.sourceVector k n L

theorem normalized_radius_error (k n : Nat) (L : Real) (hL : 0<L) (Rhat : Rat) (hRhat : 0<Rhat) : norm(NormedSpace.normalize(radiusVector k n (Rhat:Real))-ExperimentalNormalizationStability.targetVector k n L) <= 2 * Real.sqrt(gridSize(n+1):Real) * sourceLipschitzConstant k * abs((Rhat:Real)-Real.pi*L)
